:::{#def-expected-generalization-error}
#### Expected generalization error

The **expected generalization error** of a fitting procedure
at training-set size $n$
is the mean of its [generalization error](#def-generalization-error)
over training sets $\mathcal{T}$ of $n$ observations
drawn independently from the population:

$$
\expgenerr{n} \eqdef \E{\generr_{\mathcal{T}}}.
$$ {#eq-expected-generalization-error}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.2] call this quantity the *expected test error* and write it $\operatorname{Err}$;
the argument $n$ is added here because @rem-cv-estimate compares training sets of different sizes.
:::

:::
